<?php
class Reentry317 {
    public $self;
    public static $seen = 0;
    public function __construct() { $this->self = $this; }
    public function __destruct() {
        global $held, $cached;
        $id = self::$seen++;
        echo $id, "<|";
        if ($id === 0) {
            $held = Fiber::getCurrent();
            Fiber::suspend();
            $child = new Reentry317();
            $weak = WeakReference::create($child);
            unset($child);
            echo "reentry:", gc_collect_cycles(), "|";
            echo $weak->get() === null ? "child:gone|" : "child:live|";
        } elseif ($id === 1) {
            $cached = Fiber::getCurrent();
        } else {
            echo Fiber::getCurrent() === $cached ? "cached|" : "changed|";
        }
        echo $id, ">|";
    }
}
$request = new Fiber(function () {
    $a = new Reentry317();
    $b = new Reentry317();
    unset($a, $b);
    echo "first:", gc_collect_cycles(), "|";
});
$request->start();
$held->resume();
echo $held->isTerminated() ? "done|" : "pending|";
echo "last:", gc_collect_cycles(), "|END";

<?php
class Pending317 {
    public $self;
    public static $seen = 0;
    public function __construct() { $this->self = $this; }
    public function __destruct() {
        global $held;
        $id = self::$seen++;
        if ($id === 1) {
            $held = Fiber::getCurrent();
            Fiber::suspend();
        }
        throw new Exception("E" . $id);
    }
}
$request = new Fiber(function () {
    $a = new Pending317();
    $b = new Pending317();
    $c = new Pending317();
    unset($a, $b, $c);
    try {
        gc_collect_cycles();
    } catch (Exception $e) {
        echo "collect:", $e->getMessage(), ":";
        echo $e->getPrevious() === null ? "none|" : $e->getPrevious()->getMessage() . "|";
    }
});
$request->start();
try {
    $held->resume();
} catch (Exception $e) {
    echo "resume:", $e->getMessage(), ":";
    echo $e->getPrevious() === null ? "none|" : $e->getPrevious()->getMessage() . "|";
}
echo $held->isTerminated() ? "done|" : "pending|";
echo gc_collect_cycles(), "|END";

<?php
class Trace317 {
    public $self;
    public static $suspend = false;
    public function __construct() { $this->self = $this; }
    public function __destruct() {
        if (self::$suspend) {
            global $held;
            $held = Fiber::getCurrent();
            Fiber::suspend();
        }
        throw new Exception("E");
    }
}
$request = new Fiber(function () {
    $a = new Trace317();
    unset($a);
    try { gc_collect_cycles(); } catch (Exception $e) {
        $trace = $e->getTrace();
        echo "collect:", $trace[1]["function"], ":", $trace[2]["function"], "|";
    }
    unset($trace, $e);
    Trace317::$suspend = true;
    $b = new Trace317();
    unset($b);
    echo "detach:", gc_collect_cycles(), "|";
});
$request->start();
try { $held->resume(); } catch (Exception $e) {
    $trace = $e->getTrace();
    echo "resume:", $trace[1]["function"], ":", $trace[2]["function"], "|";
}
echo $held->isTerminated() ? "done|" : "pending|";
